section_v1.description: Section-aware chunking: never crosses a heading; tables are separate chunks; overlap only inside a split section.

section_v2.description: section_v1 + citation-safe normaliser, Markdown tables, PDF layout recovery (headers/footers, running titles, in-text headings), content-based exclusion of reference/contributor lists, flattened-table flag.

section_v2_1.description: section_v2 + verified page maps for PDFs converted without page markers; flattened PDF tables classified table_recovered_pending_review / table_structure_unrecoverable; repeated in-text headings kept; author-list front-matter rule limited to front pages; bare-integer headings need heading case; data-row runs flagged as flattened tables; glyph-ID text (/gidNNNNN) flagged text_encoding_lost. None of these flagged chunks is retrievable.
